resources.string: Device is not enrolled yet. Ask staff to enroll it from Support using the staff PIN.
For payment questions or help with this device, contact the shop or agent who sold you the phone. Your payment information on this app is read-only and updates after confirmed payments.
This device is managed by your provider. Lock status is controlled remotely.
Not the Device Owner yet. Provision via:\n adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.devicelock.agent/.LockAdminReceiver
Payment request sent. Confirm on your phone, then the device will update automatically.

This asks the server to release the device. It only completes if the loan is fully paid (or an owner authorizes it). Release lifts all restrictions and removes management — it cannot be undone without re-provisioning.
Not released — the loan isn\'t fully paid yet
Debug build only. Use this when test database rows were deleted before the phone was released. It removes Device Owner locally and forgets the stale enrollment.
Your installment payment is overdue. Pay via mobile money to restore access. The device unlocks automatically once your payment is confirmed. Emergency calls remain available.
